location: Capitol Extension Room E005 200 W 24th Street
title: The purpose of this meeting is to finalize the Committee's interim work. The Committee will review bill drafts and receive presentations on: 1) sexual assault reporting and reduction update; 2) firefighter death benefits; 3) GIS governance structure; 4) Wyoming Department of Transportation trust account; 5) highway funding; and 6) pari-mutuel wagering distribution for highways. The meeting will be held in-person in Cheyenne and remotely with a live video stream available on the Legislature's Website (www.wyoleg.gov).
